slides.title: *One screen. *One task.
slides.body: 5 setup rules before your next focus block.

slides.title: Close every tab you *don't *need.
slides.body: If it isn't for this task, it goes. Bookmark it if you must.

slides.title: *Full-screen the work.
slides.body: One window. Nothing at the edges asking for a click.

slides.title: Quit chat. Don't just *mute it.
slides.body: A red badge you can see still pulls your eyes.

slides.title: *Do *Not *Disturb on.
slides.body: Set it to end when the block ends, so you don't forget.

slides.title: Park stray thoughts on *paper.
slides.body: A notepad next to you. Write it down, get back to work.

slides.title: A clean screen is a *clear *head.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
